propositions: Code-review pipeline does not record or drain contract violations from verify step, while plan-review pipeline does via a private ContextVar sink in plan_review/orchestrator.py.

Per-chunk outcome_counts (clean, recovered, empty_outcomes, unrecoverable) computed inside verify_findings() are unavailable at the *_decide boundary because workflow executor merges all chunks before output reaches plan_review_decide or code_review_decide.

Both plan_review_decide and code_review_decide call reshape_verifications() and check has_violations but only plan_review reports the violation via record_contract_violation; code_review only logs an error.
A shared contract-violation sink must be extracted from plan_review/orchestrator.py into review_kernel so both pipelines use one implementation instead of duplicating or skipping the logic.

A new shared decide_outcome_counts() helper must derive whole-run outcome tallies (clean, recovered, empty_outcomes, unrecoverable always 0) from data already available at the merged *_decide boundary to unify outcome_counts emission between pipelines.
